Hi Alex — thanks again for a great discovery call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Recap: You described a centralized inference workload with sensitive PHI, 3 regional clusters (US/EU/APAC), ~120 QPS peak, and a key ask for KV cache persistence across restarts.
- Priority for the next session: an operations-focused demo that walks through Dedicated + Private deployment options, network/KMS configuration, audit logs, and a short runbook for failover.

Proposed timeline: can you confirm which of these windows works for your team? I included SE/ops options on our side. I can also convert to a shared calendar slot once you pick one.

Option A: Tue Nov 23, 10:00–11:00 PT (Redwood SE + Ops)
Option B: Wed Nov 24, 13:00–14:00 PT (Redwood SE + Solutions Architect)

Ask from your side before the demo:
- Confirm the attendee list for the session (names + roles).
- Any specific environments or example prompts you'd like us to demo (e.g., large-context retrieval, KV cache restore).

I've attached an availability grid (medisync_availability_grid.xlsx) and a short ops-demo agenda (redwood_ops-demo-agenda.pdf). If you prefer Google Meet instead of Zoom, say so and we'll send that link.

Links: availability grid: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3c-availability-grid
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234560/deal/DEAL-2026-1123-MS

Thanks — happy to be flexible on timing. If neither slot works, send two preferred windows and we'll match.

Best,
Irene Choi

irene@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
